CustomField.formula: IF( CEILING( ( Planned_Commercialization_week__c - DATE( YEAR( Planned_Commercialization_week__c ), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) > 52, 52, CEILING( ( Planned_Commercialization_week__c - DATE( YEAR( Planned_Commercialization_week__c ), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) )
CustomField.label: Commercialization Week Number
